milestone: Native CPU scalar-field record worker captures/results and recovery

implementation.shared_planner: Carries nominal record table into MLIR kernels; remaps record construction/update/read operands, including imported map callbacks
implementation.kernel_bridge: Record arguments are native aggregate values; MLIR C wrapper aggregate results use the leading output pointer, followed by checked invocation context
implementation.storage: Failure header plus scalar-field native struct payload; per-nominal-record canonical task layouts, distinct from handles and numerical layouts
implementation.lifetime: Snapshot capture and cached outcome value copies; no record payload heap allocation or backing lease; scheduler frames/bookkeeping retain existing bounded lifetimes
implementation.errors: Record-valued parallel/await/try/catch/match/fail use existing task channels and group settlement; no partial success on failure

contract.identity: Declaration table index preserved through imported helpers and nested/cached results; identical physical layouts do not unify nominal types
contract.exactness: Transport preserves integer and floating payload bits, including signed zeros, subnormal encodings, infinities, and signaling/quiet NaNs; field arithmetic retains existing numeric semantics
contract.scope: CPU scalar-field records, ordinary and nested worker helpers, repeated awaits, completed group results and recovery. Record callback captures, collection/nested fields, GPU records and record main display remain gated. Private test descriptors are not stable C/C++ or wire ABI.

scope: Debug and ASan/UBSan frontend tests cover six numeric families, nested tasks, cached record results, type identity, imported kernel metadata, catch/match/fail, task-handle and GPU gates

Trusted compiled task harness accepts a typed record parameter, overwrites the source packet and settles its context before execution, then verifies exact snapshots through nested workers and immutable updates

Cancellation/deadline before dispatch, bounded admission rejection and allocation-failure positions 1-16 at 1/4 workers; settled scheduler ledgers and no payload allocation on observation
